out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Also describes viewing from the wall looking directly at his body.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Initial panic stopped after a calm female voice said, “Relax and let go. All is well.”

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Reports a wall ‘portal/tunnel’ visible through the wall with blue sky and clouds; also describes being ‘vacuumed up’ at incredible speed.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: “pulled… at an incredible speed, like being vacuumed up.”

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus appeared after a vast hand opened and he stepped out; later emitted a brilliant, blinding light of love and merged with experiencer.
arrival.other_being_detail: Translucent bluish fluorescent clear ‘energy being’ (not human-shaped); later ‘two humongous angels’ in white; additional hooded white-robed beings; a Greek/Roman-looking being with a book.

environment.environment_other_detail: Beach where sand/water felt alive and communicative; no sun yet bright; wooden cabin of luminous wood transforming into vibrating strings of colored light; stone/glass-like golden pathway emitting light; everything ‘white, brilliant white’.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Portal/tunnel in wall ‘slowly got smaller and smaller until it closed up’; he then found himself back sitting on bed.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Jesus’ closing instruction: “Remember, all that truly matters is Love, Love is the only thing that’s real.” Experiencer later reports need to give love to all creation.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Sleep-related breathing problem; woke gasping and ‘stopped breathing’ while sitting on bed.

person_demographics.nationality_ethnicity: From a communist country (exact country not specified).
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Unaffiliated atheist; reports not knowing much about Jesus due to communist-country upbringing.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Portal/tunnel in wall; ‘hand of God’ presenting Jesus; merging with Jesus; objects/environment communicating (sand/water/wood).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE begins in bedroom with voice/beings/portal; rapid pull to beach (heaven-like realm), then cabin with Jesus/angels/books/light/merging; walk outside; thought of wife triggers return to room via portal closing.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Early phase: “both looking at my body and still in it.”

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Communicating with sand and water; wood transforming into vibrating colored light-strings; enormous hand delivering Jesus; white book written with ‘white ink’; merging into Jesus; bluish cocoon-like energy wrapping the body; portal/tunnel visible through wall with sky/clouds.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Relax and let go. All is well.” / “God is everywhere, all the time, and in everything.” / “You can be a religious person if you like, but you don’t have to be because religion is of man, not of God.” / “I heard you asking for me. So here I am. I’ve always been here with you. And you have always been here with me.” / “Remember, all that truly matters is Love, Love is the only thing that’s real.”
